40021962.author: पदार्थः
40021962.content: रामस्य of Rama, भाषितं words, श्रुत्वा having heard, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, परवीरहा destroyer of enemy heroes, उवाच spoke, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, वाक्यं words, राघवं to Rama, दीप्ततेजसम् of blazing splendor.

40021962.author: Translation
40021962.content: Having heard Rama's words, Lakshmana, the destroyer of enemy heroes, spoke with folded hands to the radiant Rama.

40021963.author: पदार्थः
40021963.content: निक्षिप्तदेहौ having cast off their bodies, काकुत्स्य O Kakutstha, कथं how, तौ those two, द्विजपार्थिवौ the Brahmin and the king, पुनः again, देहेन with a body, संयोगं union, जग्मतुः attained, देवसम्मतौ honored by the gods.

40021963.author: Translation
40021963.content: O Kakutstha, how did those two, the Brahmin and the king, who had cast off their bodies and were honored by the gods, attain union with a body again?

40021964.author: पदार्थः
40021964.content: लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, तु indeed, रामः Rama, च and, इक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः delight of Ikshvaku, प्रत्युवाच replied, महातेजाः greatly effulgent, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, पुरुषर्षभः best among men.

40021964.author: Translation
40021964.content: Rama, the greatly effulgent best among men and descendant of Ikshvaku, thus replied to Lakshmana who had spoken to him.

40021965.author: पदार्थः
40021965.content: तौ those two, परस्परशापेन by mutual curse, देहौ bodies, उत्सृज्य having abandoned, धार्मिकौ righteous ones, अभूताम् became, नृपविप्रर्षी the king and the brahmin sage, वायुभूतौ having become air, तपोधनौ whose wealth is penance.

40021965.author: Translation
40021965.content: Those two righteous ones, the king and the brahmin sage, having abandoned their bodies due to a mutual curse, became beings of air, their wealth being penance.

40021966.author: पदार्थः
40021966.content: अशरीरः bodiless, शरीरस्य for a body, कृते for the sake of, अन्यस्य another, महामुनिः the great sage, वसिष्ठः Vasishtha, सुमहातेजाः exceedingly greatly effulgent, जगाम went, पितुः of his father, अन्तिकम् to the presence.

40021966.author: Translation
40021966.content: The great sage Vasishtha, exceedingly greatly effulgent, being bodiless, went to his father's presence for the sake of another body.

40021967.author: पदार्थः
40021967.content: सः he, अभिवाद्य having saluted, ततः then, पादौ the feet, देवदेवस्य of the god of gods, धर्मवित् knower of dharma, पितामहम् to the grandfather, अथ then, उवाच spoke, वायुभूतः having become air, इदम् this, वचः word.

40021967.author: Translation
40021967.content: Then, he, the knower of dharma, having become air, saluted the feet of the god of gods, his grandfather (Brahma), and spoke these words.

40021968.author: पदार्थः
40021968.content: भगवन् O Lord, निमि Nimi, शापेन by the curse, विदेहत्वम् bodiless state, उपागमम् I have attained, लोकनाथ O Lord of the worlds, महादेव O great god, अण्डजः born from an egg, अपि even, त्वम् you, अब्जजः born from a lotus.

40021968.author: Translation
40021968.content: O Lord, O Lord of the worlds, O great god, I have attained a bodiless state due to Nimi's curse, and you yourself are born from an egg and a lotus.

40021969.author: पदार्थः
40021969.content: सर्वेषां of all, देहहीनानां of those without a body, महद्दुःखं great sorrow, भविष्यति will be, लुप्यन्ते are destroyed, सर्वकार्यणि all actions, हीनदेहस्य of one without a body, वै indeed, प्रभो O Lord, देहस्य of a body, अन्यस्य another, सद्भावे in the existence, प्रसादं favor, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि you ought.

40021969.author: Translation
40021969.content: O Lord, great sorrow will befall all those without a body, as all actions are lost for one who lacks a physical form; therefore, you ought to grant the favor of another body.

40021970.author: पदार्थः
40021970.content: तम् him, उवाच said, ततो then, ब्रह्मा Brahma, स्वयम्भूः the self-born, अमितप्रभः of immeasurable splendor, मित्रावरुणजं born of Mitra and Varuna, तेज the essence, प्रविश enter, त्वं you, महायशः O greatly renowned one.

40021970.author: Translation
40021970.content: Then, Brahma, the self-born one of immeasurable splendor, said to him, "O greatly renowned one, enter the essence born of Mitra and Varuna."

40021971.author: पदार्थः
40021971.content: अयोनिजः not born from a womb, त्वं you, भविता will be, तत्रापि even there, द्विजसत्तम O best among twice-born, धर्मेण with righteousness, महता great, युक्तः endowed, पुनः again, एष्यसि you will come, मे my, वशम् control.

40021971.author: Translation
40021971.content: O best among twice-born, even there you will be born without a womb, and endowed with great righteousness, you will again return to my control.

40021972.author: पदार्थः
40021972.content: एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, तु indeed, देवेन by the god, च and, अभिवाद्य having saluted, प्रदक्षिणम् circumambulation, कृत्वा having done, पितामहं the grandfather, तूर्णं quickly, प्रययौ went, वरुणालयम् to the abode of Varuna.

40021972.author: Translation
40021972.content: Thus spoken to by the god, and having saluted and circumambulated the grandfather Brahma, he quickly went to the abode of Varuna.

40021973.author: पदार्थः
40021973.content: तम् that, एव very, कालं time, मित्रो Mitra, अपि also, वरुणत्वम् the state of Varuna, अकारयत् caused to be done, क्षीरोदेन with the ocean of milk, सह with, उपेतः accompanied, पूज्यमानः being worshipped, सुरोत्तमैः by the best of gods.

40021973.author: Translation
40021973.content: At that very time, Mitra also performed the role of Varuna, accompanied by the Ocean of Milk and being worshipped by the best of gods.

40021974.author: पदार्थः
40021974.content: एतस्मिन्नेव काले in that very time, तु indeed, उर्वशी Urvashi, परमाप्सराः the chief Apsara, यदृच्छया by chance, तम् उद्देशम् to that place, आययौ came, सखिभिर्वृता surrounded by friends.

40021974.author: Translation
40021974.content: At that very time, Urvashi, the foremost Apsara, arrived at that place by chance, accompanied by her friends.

40021975.author: पदार्थः
40021975.content: ताम् her, दृष्ट्वा having seen, रूपसम्पन्नाम् endowed with beauty, क्रीडन्तीम् playing, वरुणालये in Varuna's abode, आविशत् entered, परमो हर्षो great joy, वरुणम् Varuna, च and, उर्वशीकृते for Urvashi's sake.

40021975.author: Translation
40021975.content: Having seen her, beautiful and playing in Varuna's abode, great joy entered Varuna because of Urvashi.

40021976.author: पदार्थः
40021976.content: सः he, ताम् her, पद्मपलाशाक्षीम् lotus-petal-eyed, पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाम् with a face like the full moon, वरुणः Varuna, वरयामास desired, मैथुनाय for union, अप्सरोवराम् the best of Apsaras.

40021976.author: Translation
40021976.content: Varuna, seeing her with lotus-petal eyes and a face like the full moon, desired her, the best of Apsaras, for union.

40021977.author: पदार्थः
40021977.content: प्रत्युवाच replied, ततः then, सा she, तु indeed, वरुणम् to Varuna, प्राञ्जलिः स्थिता standing with folded hands, मित्रेण by Mitra, अहम् I, वृता chosen, साक्षात् directly, पूर्वम् एव already, सुरेश्वर O Lord of gods.

40021977.author: Translation
40021977.content: Then she, standing with folded hands, replied to Varuna, saying, "O Lord of gods, I have already been directly chosen by Mitra."

40021978.author: पदार्थः
40021978.content: वरुणः Varuna, तु however, अब्रवीत् spoke, वाक्यम् words, कन्दर्पशरपीडितः tormented by the arrows of Kama, इदम् this, तेजः semen, समुत्स्रक्ष्ये I shall discharge, कुम्भे in the pot, अस्मिन् this, देवनिर्मिते made by gods.

40021978.author: Translation
40021978.content: Tormented by the arrows of Kama, Varuna then spoke, saying, "I shall discharge this semen into this pot made by the gods."

40021979.author: पदार्थः
40021979.content: एवम् thus, उत्सृज्य abandoning (desire), सुश्रोणि O beautiful-hipped one, त्वयि in you, अहम् I, वरवर्णिनि O lady of excellent complexion, कृतकामः one whose desire is fulfilled, भविष्यामि I shall become, यदि if, न not, इच्छसि you desire, सङ्गमम् union,

40021979.author: Translation
40021979.content: O beautiful-hipped lady of excellent complexion, if you do not desire union, I shall thus abandon my desire for you and consider my wish fulfilled.

40021980.author: पदार्थः
40021980.content: तस्य his, तत् that, लोकपालस्य of the protector of the world, वरुणस्य of Varuna, सुभाषितम् well-spoken word, उर्वशी Urvashi, परमप्रीता extremely pleased, श्रुत्वा having heard, वाक्यम् words, उवाच ह spoke indeed,

40021980.author: Translation
40021980.content: Having heard those well-spoken words of Varuna, the protector of the world, Urvashi was extremely pleased and spoke.

40021981.author: पदार्थः
40021981.content: कामम् indeed, एतत् this, भवतु let it be, एवम् thus, हृदयम् heart, मे my, त्वयि in you, स्थितम् situated, भावः च अपि and also feeling, अधिकः great, तुभ्यम् for you, देहः body, मित्रस्य of Mitra, तु but, प्रभो O lord,

40021981.author: Translation
40021981.content: O lord, let it be so; my heart is indeed fixed on you, and my affection for you is great, but my body belongs to Mitra.

40021982.author: पदार्थः
40021982.content: उर्वश्या by Urvashi, एवम् thus, उक्तः तु having been spoken to, indeed, रेतः semen, तत् that, महत् great, अद्भुतम् wonderful, ज्वलत् burning, अग्निशिखा flame of fire, प्रख्यम् resembling, तस्मिन् in that, कुम्भे pot, हि indeed, अपासृजत् he discharged,

40021982.author: Translation
40021982.content: Thus addressed by Urvashi, he indeed discharged that great and wonderful semen, resembling a burning flame of fire, into that pot.

40021983.author: पदार्थः
40021983.content: उर्वशी Urvashi, तु but, अगमत् went, तत्र there, मित्रः Mitra, वै indeed, यत्र where, देवता the deity, ताम् her, तु but, मित्रः Mitra, सुसङ्क्रम्य having approached well, उर्वशीम् to Urvashi, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke,

40021983.author: Translation
40021983.content: But Urvashi went to the place where the deity Mitra was, and Mitra, having approached her, spoke these words to Urvashi.

40021984.author: पदार्थः
40021984.content: मया by me, निमन्त्रिता invited, पूर्वम् previously, कस्मात् why, त्वम् you, अवसर्जिता abandoned, पतिम् husband, अन्यम् another, वृतवती chosen, तस्मात् therefore, त्वम् you, दुष्टचारिणी ill-behaved woman.

40021984.author: Translation
40021984.content: Why did you abandon me, whom I had previously invited, and choose another husband; therefore, you are an ill-behaved woman.

40021985.author: पदार्थः
40021985.content: अनेन by this, दुष्कृतेन misdeed, त्वम् you, मत्क्रोधकलुषीकृता sullied by my wrath, मनुष्यलोकम् the human world, आस्थाय having resorted to, कञ्चित्कालम् for some time, निवत्स्यसि you will reside.

40021985.author: Translation
40021985.content: Due to this misdeed, you, sullied by my wrath, will reside in the human world for some time.

40021986.author: पदार्थः
40021986.content: बुधस्य of Budha, पुत्रः son, राजर्षिः royal sage, काशीराजः king of Kashi, पुरूरवाः Pururavas, तम् him, अद्य today, गच्छ go, दुर्बुद्धे O ill-minded one, सः he, ते your, भर्ता husband, भविष्यति will be.

40021986.author: Translation
40021986.content: Go today to Pururavas, the royal sage, son of Budha and king of Kashi, O ill-minded one, for he will be your husband.

40021987.author: पदार्थः
40021987.content: ततः then, सा she, शापदोषेण by the effect of the curse, पुरूरवसम् to Pururavas, अभ्यगात् went, प्रतियाते to the one who had returned, पुरूरवम् Pururavas, बुधस्य of Budha, आत्मजम् son, औरसम् legitimate.

40021987.author: Translation
40021987.content: Then she, by the effect of the curse, went to Pururavas, the legitimate son of Budha, who had returned.

40021988.author: पदार्थः
40021988.content: तस्य to him, जज्ञे was born, ततः then, श्रीमान् glorious, आयुः Ayus, पुत्रः son, महाबलः very powerful, नहुषः Nahusha, यस्य whose, पुत्रस्तु son, however, बभूव became, इन्द्रसमद्युतिः having splendor equal to Indra.

40021988.author: Translation
40021988.content: Then to him was born a glorious and very powerful son named Ayus, whose son, Nahusha, became one with splendor equal to Indra.

40021989.author: पदार्थः
40021989.content: वज्रम् thunderbolt, उत्सृज्य having cast, वृत्राय at Vritra, भ्रान्ते having erred, अथ then, त्रिदिवेश्वरे when the lord of the three heavens (Indra), शतम् a hundred, वर्षसहस्राणि thousands of years, येन by whom, इन्द्रत्वम् the position of Indra, प्रशासितम् was ruled

40021989.author: Translation
40021989.content: This refers to the one who ruled as Indra for a hundred thousand years when the actual Indra was agitated after casting his thunderbolt at Vritra.

40021990.author: पदार्थः
40021990.content: सा she, तेन by that, शापेन curse, जगाम went, भूमिम् to the earth, तदा then, उर्वशी Urvashi, चारुदती having beautiful teeth, सुनेत्रा having beautiful eyes, बहूनि many, वर्षाणि years, अवसत् resided, च and, सुभ्रूः having beautiful eyebrows, शापक्षयात् from the end of the curse, इन्द्रसदः to Indra's assembly, ययौ went, च and

40021990.author: Translation
40021990.content: That Urvashi, with beautiful teeth, eyes, and eyebrows, then went to the earth due to that curse, resided there for many years, and returned to Indra's assembly upon the curse's expiration. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षट्पञ्चाशः सर्गः ।। 56 ।। Thus ends the fifty-sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
